name: agents
description: A five-agent complexity ladder (Operator, Researcher, Builder, Specialist, Reviewer), generic and portable across projects, with matching Codex TOML profiles hand-written from the same source.

interface.shortDescription: A five-agent complexity ladder: Operator, Researcher, Builder, Specialist, Reviewer.
interface.longDescription: Generic, portable agent profiles spanning a complexity ladder: Operator executes fully specified instructions, Researcher investigates read-only across any source, Builder implements inside a scoped task, Specialist solves hard or cross-cutting problems, and Reviewer validates a plan, diff, or decision. Each agent is written once and shared verbatim across Claude Code and Codex.
